motifs.name: soar
motifs.note: up a sixth off the fifth, in three-three-two; then it waits, and the wait is where the strings answer

motifs.name: climb
motifs.note: up the sixth chord to the top of the tune, held across the barline

motifs.name: hijaz
motifs.note: the cadence: leading note, flat sixth, fifth -- the augmented second -- and home

motifs.name: climb_neap
motifs.note: the climb over the flat second: one note bends

motifs.name: hijaz_last
motifs.note: the cadence with nothing after it

motifs.name: sabi
motifs.note: the chorus, eight bars: the cell twice, a step lower the second time, down the fifths; the climb; the cadence

motifs.name: sabi_up
motifs.note: the chorus as it goes the second time

motifs.name: taqsim
motifs.note: the solo's own two bars: down the flat-second chord, then a turn through the augmented second onto a trill

motifs.name: prelude
motifs.note: the chorus's head, and where the solo takes it instead

motifs.name: riff_a
motifs.note: a bar of eighths around the tonic, a bar of three-three-two

motifs.name: riff_b
motifs.note: the same on the flat second, then up the dominant

motifs.name: riff
motifs.note: a bar of eighths around the tonic, a bar of three-three-two

motifs.name: riff_end
motifs.note: the riff and its last note

motifs.name: ask
motifs.note: enters off the beat, climbs a fifth, bites, comes back

motifs.name: ask_2
motifs.note: a step further, and out through the augmented second

motifs.name: reach
motifs.note: the same entry a fifth up: the verse's high point

motifs.name: turn_home
motifs.note: down and up the flat-second chord, to the dominant

motifs.name: turn_away
motifs.note: verse two's ending: it does not go home, it climbs the dominant of the relative major

motifs.name: verse
motifs.note: enters off the beat, climbs a fifth, bites, comes back

motifs.name: ask_2_sung
motifs.note: a step further, and out through the augmented second

motifs.name: reach_sung
motifs.note: the same entry a fifth up: the verse's high point

motifs.name: verse_sung
motifs.note: the verse decorated, with the other ending

motifs.name: long_1
motifs.note: long notes that keep rising: everything the verse was not

motifs.name: long_2
motifs.note: higher, and then it stays on one note for two bars while the chord under it turns into D minor's dominant

motifs.name: bridge
motifs.note: long notes that keep rising: everything the verse was not

motifs.name: run
motifs.note: two octaves of hijaz, from the dominant to the dominant

motifs.name: under
motifs.note: the counter-line: it only ever goes up, a step at a time, while the tune falls in sequence

motifs.name: under_neap
motifs.note: through the flat second

motifs.name: answer
motifs.note: the strings' reply in the tune's gap: up a fifth and back

motifs.name: reply
motifs.note: the strings in the verse's gaps: a turn and a fall, in unison

motifs.name: pivot
motifs.note: up the dominant seventh of the key a step above: four notes that are not in D minor, and then it is E minor

motifs.name: thrum
motifs.note: the bass under the verse, on the dums of the maqsum

motifs.name: sigh
motifs.note: the cello under verse two

ops.note: the hook, alone, before anything has a pulse
the tune, plainly
decorated, and it ends by climbing away
the piano stops singing and glitters
alone but for a held note and a snare
the tune the solo promised
the key change, announced
a whole step up
octaves for the second half
the strings answer the piano, as they do in this music
in the first gap
and the second, a step lower like the tune
the strings stop answering and join
the tune in the strings from the first note
the counter-line, in brass now
the run is the orchestra's, not one hand's
the roots, sung
room in the middle for the tune
maqsum in the strings: the low note on the dums, the chord on the taks
a tremolo of plucks behind everything
under the trill: the first sign that this is not a nocturne
a roll on A, which is the fifth of the key that is about to arrive
the cymbals were washing over the snare
